scope: Diagnostic calculations only. No production definitions, presets, or accepted DPS snapshots changed.
reference: BT19, Fully Relayed Max Short Fight, Grounded Dummy 30 Sec IV, 40ms, Simmering Fish Slices, Fire Divinecraft; Boss Talent initially zero.

scenarioNotes.bossTalent15: Adds 15% Category 1 damage, equivalent to the existing Boss Talent option. A setup difference, not evidence to enable it by default.
scenarioNotes.shieldAlwaysActual: Removes the Shield condition from the existing Rain Whisper bonus in the probe only. Upper bound, not a claim of valid permanent shield uptime.
scenarioNotes.secondGoldenBeforeLastFanQ: Adds GoldenBodyCancel immediately before the final existing EmeraldBarrier. Fan Q is its legal cancel follow-up. Shield application remains delayed 0.5 seconds and cooldown remains 20 seconds.
scenarioNotes.lateHP0_25: Sets self HP to 25% at battle time 25 seconds; subsequent damage and leech still resolve normally.
scenarioNotes.boss15LateHP25: Combines the Boss Talent and late low-HP diagnostic assumptions; not a validated match to the screenshot.

simulationMethod: 300 production calculateSimulatedRotationRun calls with an LCG seed 4097, multiplier 1664525, increment 1013904223, uint32 divided by 2^32. Screenshot exceedance counts are descriptive of this sample, not an exact probability.
unresolved: Actual screenshot gear, Boss Talent, shield source/uptime, self HP and attack rolls are unknown.
The review did not independently validate Mystic enlightenment scaling or the complete general damage formula. These remain candidates for raw-source verification, not established errors.
